title: A Survey of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating coreference resolution performance using the WinoGender dataset to assess gender stereotypes in language models.
Computing perplexity scores on the CrowS-Pairs dataset to determine the models' preferences for stereotypic versus anti-stereotypic sentence pairs.
Reviewing and assessing cognitive biases when LLMs act as automated evaluators, specifically tracking order bias, length preference, and self-generation preference using benchmarks like MT-Bench.
